heading_en: Transitional Measures Accompanying the Partial Amendment of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc.
summary_ja: 適用日から3年間、第2条の2の適用上、表に従い第3項の2.5%等を段階的に読み替える。
summary_en: For three years from the Application Date, replaces wording in Article 2-2, paragraphs (3) and (4) according to a table so that the buffer requirement phases in (25%, 50%, 75%).
paragraphs: With respect to the application of Article 2-2 of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc., as amended by the provisions of Article 5, during the period until the date three years have elapsed from the Application Date, according to the period category set out in column 1 of the following table, the words set out in column 3 of the table in the provisions set out in column 2 of the table are deemed to be replaced with the words set out in column 4 of the table, respectively. {{T:p438t0}}
